works.title: IELTS Listening Practice 3
works.desc:
IELTS Listening mashqi: 4 ta Part, 40 ta savol.
Har bir Part boshidagi “Audioni boshlash” tugmasini bosing — audio faqat bir marta eshittiriladi.
Javoblarni yozishda imloga e’tibor bering: har bir bo‘sh joyga talab qilingan miqdordagi so‘z yoki raqam yoziladi.

questions.text:
Part 1

Listen and answer questions 1–10.

Questions 1-10 Complete the notes below.

Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

INCIDENT REPORT

Example

Name: Anna Lumley
Telephone:
Date of arrival:
Address: 235 {akendale} Road, East sea
The total value of insurance: $ {3450}

Missing items:

– lamps and chairs (not expensive)
– furniture and {books}
– a rocking horse, some {paintings} and fruit bowls
Items ordered: – a clock
– a {mirror}
Damaged items: – the {desk} needs to be replaced
– a {leg} of one of the dining chairs is split
– four {plates} were broken

Part 2

Listen and answer questions 11–20.

Questions 11-16

Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.
What was Jill surprised to find?
options: Some work to reduce the water usage to her house could be done soon.
The house was poorly insulated.
She could get financial help.

questions.text: What does Jill say every family can do straight away?
options: Use energy-saving bulbs.
Turn down the thermostat.
Turn off their appliances completely.

questions.text: What pleased Jill about the energy provider?
options: reduction in price for prompt payment
allowing customers to pay online
having a reduction in price of the energy-saving sources

questions.text: What difficulty does Jill have with the energy meters?
options: They are difficult to access.
The figures are hard to read accurately.
She can't tell whether they're for electricity or for gas.

questions.text: What kind of energy-saving method is Jill going to take next?
options: Use an energy-saving boiler.
Have the walls checked for their insulation level.
Install double-glazed windows.

questions.text: Why is Jill doubtful about renewable energy?
options: She thinks it's unsuitable for her house.
She doesn't understand the technical details.
She believes it's too expensive.

questions.text: Questions 17-18 Choose TWO letters, A-E.
Which TWO water-saving tips does Jill recommend?
options: use more showers than baths
keep the washing machine full before using it
boil only as much water as you need
turn off the taps while you are brushing your teeth
repair leaking taps

questions.text: Questions 19-20 Choose TWO letters, A-E.
Which TWO topics do people most frequently ask about?
options: the ideal temperature setting on the thermostat
whether to leave the light on or not
whether to use a computer or laptop to watch movies
how to work out the operating cost of appliances
whether solar panels only work on sunny days

questions.text:
Part 3

Listen and answer questions 21–30.

Questions 21-25

Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.
Why did James choose to work in the bakery?
options: Because it's close to his home.
Because it has a good reputation in the subject area.
Because it's a part of a chain.

questions.text: What was James surprised at in his studies?
options: He finds the theoretical courses easy.
He can finish the theoretical courses.
He finds the theoretical work interesting.

questions.text: How is James' course assessed in the first term?
options: The marks are given by students to each other.
Self-assessment.
It is up to the practical experience.

questions.text: Why has Kate enquired about the English language course?
options: She wants to become an artist.
It is her first language.
She plans to curate in a gallery.

questions.text: What else did Kate need to get before going to the college?
options: starting date of the course
an offer with scholarships
a catalogue of modules

questions.text:
Questions 26-30 What statement applies to each of the following courses?

Choose FIVE answers from the box and choose the correct letter for questions 26-30.

pairs.r: Many outside speakers will give a talk.
Expensive materials need to be bought.
People stay at the studio where the course is taken.
Students need to spend a lot of money on a camera with a good display.

extra: There are a lot of background readings.

questions.text:
Part 4

Listen and answer questions 31–40.

Questions 31-40 Complete the notes below.

Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.

Birds in New Zealand

Facts
• The birds often build their nests along the coastline or next to the {river}.
• In 1984. researchers found that there were {3 pairs} of this kind of bird left.
• It is difficult to {estimate} the number of birds accurately.
Influencing factors
• Human activities, such as {farming} and building homes threaten the bird population.
• The birds are influenced by many species which can eat their {eggs}.
• Natural disasters like {storms} can also reduce the population of the birds.
Ways of protection
• The zoo should hire a {guard} to keep the birds from being poached
• The organizer could build {fence} to prevent the public from getting closer.
• People should make more of an effort to protect {wild} birds.
• Through the {media}, people will learn more about bird protection.
